display_title: Because It's Halloween, We're Reversing It!
description:
Da-on, who was dissatisfied with his position, prepares a Halloween party for his lover Hyun-woo.

"Reverse potion, werewolf cookie" Da-on bought some interesting items at a prop shop he happened to enter. After eating werewolf cookies, Da-on got dog ears. Huh? Something changed in Hyun-woo after taking the reverse potion!

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)
